verified_eligible_batters.name: Ajinkya Rahane
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Premier replacement for Sanju Samson at No. 3. Stabilizes early collapse, anchors while Jaiswal/Parag attack, and provides veteran captaincy support.
verified_eligible_batters.risks: Susceptible to express 150kph hard-length bowling if required run rate crosses 12 early.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Nitish Rana
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Elite middle-overs spin destructor. Smashes wrist-spin and SLA at 155+ SR, balancing RR middle order alongside Parag and Jurel.
verified_eligible_batters.risks: Occasional vulnerability to back-of-a-length seam in powerplays.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Nehal Wadhera
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: High-ceiling young Indian left-handed finisher. Phenomenal composure in death chases (145+ SR), solves RR’s lower-order finishing void.
verified_eligible_batters.risks: Still developing consistency against top-tier international mystery spin.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Shimron Hetmyer
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Proven Rajasthan Royals match-winner. Re-acquiring him at a rational price after release provides instant death-overs boundary violence.
verified_eligible_batters.risks: Utilizes 1 of RR’s 3 remaining overseas slots; price inflation in open bidding.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Rahul Tripathi
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Aggressive intent-first Indian No. 3 striker. Takes down pace in powerplays with 140+ SR, allowing Jaiswal to play deep.
verified_eligible_batters.risks: High-risk shot selection can result in early dismissal streaks.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Mahipal Lomror
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Former RR academy prodigy and explosive left-handed spin enforcer. Cheap domestic middle-order muscle with part-time SLA bowling.
verified_eligible_batters.risks: Struggles when denied room outside off against high pace.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Abishek Porel
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Dynamic Indian wicketkeeper-batter. Fulfills crucial backup keeper slot for Dhruv Jurel and provides aggressive powerplay hitting.
verified_eligible_batters.risks: Relatively small sample size in high-pressure IPL eliminators.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Asif Khan
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Unmatched 196.52 pressure strike rate. Ultra-budget overseas power finisher who can turn impossible chases in overs 18–20.
verified_eligible_batters.risks: Associate background; untested on turning Chepauk or Lucknow surfaces.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Rachin Ravindra
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Elite young multi-format all-rounder. Offers top-order batting elegance plus 4 overs of left-arm orthodox spin on dry Jaipur wickets.
verified_eligible_batters.risks: Overseas slot utilization; strike rate deceleration against defensive spin.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Fakhar Zaman
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Explosive international enforcer with 183.89 pressure SR. Dismantles express pace in powerplays and steep chases.
verified_eligible_batters.risks: Can be tied down by disciplined left-arm finger spin in powerplay.

verified_eligible_bowlers.name: Matheesha Pathirana
verified_eligible_bowlers.why_target: Generational death bowling phenom. 61 clutch wickets and 7.90 pressure economy. Pairs with Sandeep Sharma to form an impenetrable death-overs wall.
verified_eligible_bowlers.risks: Workload management and shoulder/hamstring niggles; will command intense bidding war.

verified_eligible_bowlers.name: Trent Boult
verified_eligible_bowlers.why_target: Legendary Rajasthan Royals powerplay icon returning home. Immediate swing breakthroughs in overs 1–6, relieving pressure on Archer and Shami.
verified_eligible_bowlers.risks: Age 37; diminished impact if pitch offers zero swing.

verified_eligible_bowlers.name: Avesh Khan
verified_eligible_bowlers.why_target: High-pace Indian death bowler with 57 clutch wickets. Protects RR’s overseas slots while delivering 145+ kph wide yorkers and hard bouncers.
verified_eligible_bowlers.risks: Can be expensive when line errs onto pads in small grounds.

verified_eligible_bowlers.name: Mustafizur Rahman
verified_eligible_bowlers.why_target: World’s premier off-cutter and change-of-pace wizard. Exceptional 7.87 pressure economy on abrasive Sawai Mansingh Stadium pitches.
verified_eligible_bowlers.risks: Vulnerable to straight-line power hitting if ball gets wet with dew.

verified_eligible_bowlers.name: Wanindu Hasaranga
verified_eligible_bowlers.why_target: Elite wicket-taking leg-spinner and lower-order boundary striker. Forms a devastating spin partnership with Bishnoi and Jadeja.
verified_eligible_bowlers.risks: Overseas slot competition; occasionally leaks runs when batsmen read his wrong’un.

verified_eligible_bowlers.name: Deepak Chahar
verified_eligible_bowlers.why_target: Premier Indian powerplay swing bowler. Bowls 3 overs upfront with precision seam, adding valuable lower-order batting depth.
verified_eligible_bowlers.risks: Injury history and limited efficacy in death overs (overs 18–20).

verified_eligible_bowlers.name: Maheesh Theekshana
verified_eligible_bowlers.why_target: Carrom-ball mystery spinner offering sub-8 economy in powerplay and death. High dot-ball percentage (42.4%) chokes run rates.
verified_eligible_bowlers.risks: Zero batting ability; fielding mobility concerns.

verified_eligible_bowlers.name: Tushar Deshpande
verified_eligible_bowlers.why_target: Indian domestic seamer with 41 clutch wickets. Dependable middle-overs strike option who knows RR team culture.
verified_eligible_bowlers.risks: High economy rate (10.22 in pressure situations) when under assault.

verified_eligible_bowlers.name: Akash Deep
verified_eligible_bowlers.why_target: Test-proven Indian hit-the-deck fast bowler. Generates steep bounce from back of a length; excellent backup for Shami and Sandeep.

verified_eligible_bowlers.name: Haris Rauf
verified_eligible_bowlers.why_target: 150+ kph express tearaway death spearhead. 43 pressure wickets with 39.7% dot-ball rate; terrifying yorkers in overs 16–20.
verified_eligible_bowlers.risks: Overseas slot utilization; susceptible to ramp/scoop shots against pace.
